The structure of Li3FeO4 is triclinic, space group P1 (No. 1), with a 8-atom unit cell and 8 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies octahedral FeO6 environments (Fe–O distances 1.91–2.05 Å), while Li centers show 4- or 6-coordinate oxygen environments. The FeO6 octahedra exhibit corner-sharing with one another, and corner- and edge-sharing with Li polyhedra, forming a 3D connected neighbor network. Oxygen environments range from 4- to 6-coordinate, with mixed Li and Fe neighbors.
